decision_table.name: Determine_MD_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Maryland state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in MD (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Maryland filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: MD Comptroller of Maryland Publication 19 (Corporation Income Tax Guide) Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-402 (Filing requirements)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Maryland filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts in Maryland
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-101 (Economic nexus provisions)
No Maryland nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MD_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Maryland state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Maryland state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction - Bonus depreciation (MD decouples from federal accelerated depreciation) - State tax refunds
Subtractions may include: - Interest on Maryland and other state/municipal bonds - State income taxes paid - Maryland NOL deduction (subject to limitations)
Reference: MD Form 500 Instructions (Schedule of Income Modifications) Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-306 (Additions to federal taxable income) Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-307 (Subtractions from federal taxable income)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MD_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Maryland state corporate income tax. Applies MD 8.25% flat tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Maryland state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to MD: × [Apportionment % using single-sales factor] 3. State additions: + [Additions per MD Tax-General Code § 10-306] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions per MD Tax-General Code § 10-307] 5. MD taxable income: = [Result] 6. MD tax rate: × 8.25% 7. MD income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. MD credits: - [Credits (R&D, job creation, biotechnology, etc.)] 9. MD tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: MD Form 500 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions Reference: MD Comptroller Publication 19 (Corporation Income Tax Guide) Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-105 (Tax rate: 8.25%)
No Maryland nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.

No Maryland taxable income - no tax liability. Maryland NOL carryforward rules may apply (not implemented).
Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-305 (Net operating loss deduction)
